research_objective: Endemic-bird habitat risk assessment in Sri Lanka
time_window: 2010-2023; forecast experiments start after the 2010-2014 calibration period
weights_status: Transparent equal-contribution analytical baseline; expert weights have not been obtained. Do not optimize index weights for prediction accuracy.
missing_data_policy: Require all four core measurements for HRI; fit predictor imputers within training folds only
ml_target: HRI(t+1), with HRI(t) and known forest measurements at end of t
model_plan: HRI_t_plus_1: Ridge, Random Forest, XGBoost; compare mean, persistence and known-component-transition baselines
notes: Forest-oriented relative index. Scientific approval of weights, thresholds and grid remains pending. HRI(t+1) is a constructed response, not independent ecological ground truth.
